run_depth_inference: run depth map inference on images using a monocular depth estimation model with config and checkpoint
run_depth_with_flip: run depth inference with left-right flip augmentation and average the two predictions for better accuracy
run_depth_with_segmentation: run depth inference combined with segmentation masks to isolate foreground depth values and save results
run_depth_normal_visualization: run depth map inference and compute surface normals using Sobel gradients for visualization
run_depth_batch_processing: run batch depth estimation on a directory of images or a list of image paths from a text file
